description: This file defines the `SudoStreamSnapshots` class, an immutable Java class representing a command to start streaming snapshots with configurable parameters such as burst count, timeout, lower bound, and selected fields. It includes methods for creation from parameters or JSON, and for manipulating its state. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project, handling streaming snapshot requests in a model service.

classes.name: SudoStreamSnapshots
classes.description: Immutable class representing a command to start streaming snapshots with configuration parameters such as burst size, timeout, lower bound, and snapshot fields.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new `SudoStreamSnapshots` command from specified burst, timeout, fields list, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new `SudoStreamSnapshots` command from a JSON object and optional headers.

methods.name: withLowerBound
methods.description: Returns a copy of the command with the specified lower bound set.

methods.name: getLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound entity ID for the stream.

methods.name: hasNonEmptyLowerBound
methods.description: Indicates whether the lower bound is set and non-dummy.

methods.name: getSnapshotFields
methods.description: Returns the JSON array of snapshot fields requested.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the burst size for the stream.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload fields to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix for this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, e.g., QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with specified headers.
